meta.format: Every figure is {value, source_url, checked[, note]}. Fees in USD. null value = the state does not publish it; see note.
meta.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. State fees change; recheck before quoting.

office.value: NJ Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES)

filing_fee.note: DORES fee page, last updated July 1, 2026. Some third-party sites still show $125.

annual_report_fee.note: Plus a card or e-check convenience fee when paid online.

annual_report_due.value: Last day of the month in which the LLC was originally formed, every year

annual_report_penalty.value: Revocation after failing to file annual reports for two consecutive years; reinstatement needs tax clearance

processing_online.note: The state does not publish an online processing time. Expedite fees apply only to over-the-counter filings: $25 per filing, $500 for 2-hour, $1,000 for 1-hour service.

state_tax_registration.value: NJ-REG within 60 days of filing the new business entity; if you'll collect sales tax, at least 15 days before your first sale
state_tax_registration.note: NJ-REG instructions revised 08/2025. Formation and NJ-REG are two separate online filings.

registered_agent.value: Required: one individual or a business entity in good standing with the State Treasurer, with a New Jersey street address for the registered office (a PO box only alongside a street address)

office.value: NY Department of State, Division of Corporations

annual_report_fee.note: New York has no annual report. It requires a $9 biennial statement instead.

annual_report_due.value: Biennial statement every two years, in the calendar month the LLC was formed; can't be filed before that month

processing_online.note: The Department of State does not publish an online processing time. Expedited handling, per document: $25 for 24-hour, $75 for same-day, $150 for 2-hour.

publication.note: Publish once a week for six weeks in two newspapers (one daily, one weekly) designated by the county clerk, then file the Certificate of Publication. Missing the 120-day deadline suspends the LLC's authority to do business. Newspaper costs vary widely by county.

state_tax_registration.value: No general state tax registration at formation. If you'll make taxable sales, register for a Sales Tax Certificate of Authority at least 20 days before beginning business

registered_agent.value: The LLC must designate the Secretary of State as its agent for service of process and give an address where the state can mail any process it receives
